provenance.source_archive: NCPOR Antarctic Meteorological Observation Structure (IIG/IMD AWS Calibrated Profile)

weather_regimes.name: Period A: Stable Polar Cold
weather_regimes.description: Stable cold conditions with moderate ESE coastal drainage winds.

weather_regimes.name: Period B: Temperature Decline
weather_regimes.description: Progressive nocturnal radiational cooling under clear polar skies.

weather_regimes.name: Period C: Increasing Maritime Wind
weather_regimes.description: Approaching low-pressure system in Prydz Bay; maritime winds ramp sharply.

weather_regimes.name: Period D: Strong Wind Event / Coastal Blizzard
weather_regimes.description: Severe maritime blizzard with wind gusts exceeding 50 knots; field access restricted.

weather_regimes.name: Period E: Cold-Wind Chill Peak
weather_regimes.description: Dangerous simultaneous combination of severe sub-zero cold and sustained gale winds.

weather_regimes.name: Period F: Synoptic Weather Recovery
weather_regimes.description: System passes out to sea; winds moderate and logistics accessibility window reopens.
